# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest 1.x minor release receives security fixes. Upgrade to it before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Use "Report a vulnerability" on the [Security tab](https://github.com/nxiglobal/factro-sdk/security) of this repository.

Include the affected version, a description of the problem and, if possible, a minimal reproduction. Never include a real factro API token.

Reports are handled on a best-effort basis; there is no guaranteed response time.
